0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-4, on a four-game losing streak, 0-2 at home) host the Detroit Pistons (4-1, on a one-game winning streak, 1st in the East and Central) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game. The teams have not met yet this season, and Brooklyn lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 138-100 loss in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (out, shoulder sprain), and Egor Demin is day-to-day with a leg bruise and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain).
